subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for same-route Gemini textSignature values on visible text blocks?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve valid same-route signatures, while this issue shows unbounded visible-text signatures can bloat persisted sessions and abort channel replies; changing that contract safely requires provider ownership.

options.title: Bound visible-text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but drop, cap, or externalize visible textSignature values before persisted replay.

options.title: Keep current replay
options.body: Accept the ongoing session-bloat risk in exchange for preserving every current same-route Gemini signature exactly as stored.

options.title: Split policy first
options.body: Open or designate a narrower design item for Google signature retention and keep implementation blocked until that policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Bound visible-text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but drop, cap, or externalize visible textSignature values before persisted replay.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Google reasoning and signature-bloat history makes this the best available routing owner for a provider replay contract choice.
